releaseEvidence: The official v8.28.0 release announces optional registration without a phone number.
The same release describes a small one-time anti-spam fee and states that the in-app purchase is not directly associated with the new account.
The implementation uses a purchase-specific receipt credential presentation to register without an E164 or registration session, matching the release claim.

The public announcement lags the first complete implementation tag: the core purchase and end-to-end commits are already contained by v8.27.0, so the base is moved back to v8.26.4, the newest tag without the released purchase journey.
observedStateTransitions: Phone-number entry -> RegisterWithoutNumber -> price loading -> available purchase.
Available purchase -> LaunchRequired -> purchase completed -> receipt redeemed -> Registered -> login information.
Previously paid but unredeemed purchase -> resume with persisted request context -> successful redemption -> consume once.
Login information -> password-manager save -> read-back confirmation -> AddUsername.
Login information -> manual save details -> re-enter matching account ID and recovery key -> AddUsername.
Username draft -> debounced reservation -> confirmed username -> registration complete.
Username step -> skip warning -> dismiss and continue editing, or confirm and complete without a username.
failureRecoveryEvidence: Transient price lookup failures expose PriceRetryClicked and recover to an available price.
Purchase cancellation leaves the payment state usable and does not navigate or report success.
Pending, redemption-failed, and registration-failed purchases remain unconsumed and are reused on retry.
Missing or repairable Google Play services expose a recovery action, foreground recheck, and price reload.
Password-manager interruption is retried once; cancellation, mismatch, or missing credentials keep the user in the preservation flow and allow manual fallback.
Mistyped manual credentials remain editable, and username reservation errors retry after dismissal without losing the draft.

facts: v8.26.4 contains preliminary numberless screens and basic account-registration scaffolding but predates the commit that adds a usable one-time purchase and receipt-redemption pipeline.
SignalLoginPurchaseStep.kt, SignalLoginPurchaseTest.kt, the manual-save view model, and the manual credential-confirmation view model are absent from v8.26.4 and present in v8.28.0.
The purchase implementation commit is absent from v8.26.4 and first appears in the next release-line tag, v8.27.0.
The focused v8.26.4-to-v8.28.0 diff adds more than three thousand lines across the selected production and test paths, rather than only changing a feature gate.

boundaryAudit.latestAbsentTagJustification: v8.26.4 is the final tag before the one-time purchase, receipt-redemption, credential-confirmation, and end-to-end implementation commits. v8.27.0 already contains those commits.

nonHappyPaths: network or redemption retry without double charge
